findings.evidence: Identical POST body and fixture require HTTP 201 and HTTP 400 respectively.
FX-API-RESET contains zero demo_reset_execution rows while the test expects a fixed reset ID to return 200.
The request uses internal.operations.cookie while OpenAPI requires SCOPE-DEMO-ADMIN.
FX-EXPIRED-SESSION derives the stored hash from the attendant cookie, but the request uses the operations cookie.
VALID_DEMO_INTERNAL_SESSION is referenced but not defined by any repository artifact.
Expected constraint identifiers differ from the identifiers in the applied PostgreSQL schema.
The precondition names seed manifest v2.1.0, while the executable G1 seed contract is v2.1.3.
